Subject: Training on customer data — opt-out?

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really useful conversation. Quick recap from our side and a small ask to make sure we capture AcmeFin's data handling requirements correctly before we move to contract: 

- Recap: Redwood will serve inference for AcmeFin's customer support routing use case. Primary inputs are customer messages (text) and metadata (case ID, region).
- PII scope: please confirm whether the message text will contain sensitive PII (SSNs, payment card numbers, health data). If yes, we will recommend additional redaction and logging controls.
- Logging & retention: by default, our hosted API retains request/response logs for 30 days for debugging unless configured otherwise. Do you need a shorter retention window or event-level logging disabled?
- Data residency: you mentioned US-only. We can pin inference to US regions and restrict backups.
- Training-on-customer-data: per your question, Redwood can ensure customer data is not used to improve models (no training-on-customer-data) if AcmeFin signs our opt-out addendum.

Next steps: can you confirm the opt-out and send a signed copy of the opt-out addendum? I've attached the one-page form in case it's helpful (HTML form link included below). Once we receive it we will: (1) record the opt-out on your account, (2) turn off any downstream model improvement flows, and (3) update the HubSpot deal and internal playbook.

Doc link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/opt-out-form-acmefin (view-only)

If you prefer, I can send the DocuSign request so Alice can sign directly.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
